en: Vintage multi‑view postcard with a central female figure in a long dress standing before a large Greek flag and holding a smaller flag and a white flower. Around her are three inset images: at upper right, a busy harbor scene labeled as Tinos with many boats and crowds; at lower right, an interior filled with hanging votive offerings and religious objects; at lower left, an image of a decorated religious icon or shrine with Greek text. Decorative roses and foliage surround the vignettes, and there is printed Greek handwriting‑style text in the upper left.
